name: fillet_face_between_two_faces_of_a_cube
why: ENTRY GP7, the half that was missing: the FACE fillet, resting on two faces instead of on one edge. Four historical attempts with FeatureFillet3 (Ftyp=Face, marks 1/2) returned NULL. The API guide gave the two causes: FeatureFillet3 has been obsolete for face fillets since 2020 (FeatureFillet3.html, Remarks) and the marks are 2 and 4 (ISimpleFilletFeatureData2.html, Remarks, line «Face fillet/face-face chamfer»), not the values 1/2 of swSimpleFilletWhichFaces_e, which is the parameter of SetFaces. This is the piece of the Checks/FaceFillet probe (28/9/2026), redone with the bridge: same cube, same two faces, same radius.
_the_number: A fillet of radius r on an edge of length L between two planar faces at 90 degrees removes L*r^2*(1 - pi/4): 40 * 25 * 0.2146018 = 214.602 mm3. The probe measured 214.6 (to the tenth) with the recipe of the guide, and 0 with the old method.
_the_defect_the_centroid_catches: The volume alone does not say WHICH edge was rounded: the twelve edges of the cube would all remove 214.6. The removed material is on the corner x = +20, z = +40 (front and right), with its centroid 1.117 mm from the edge: the centroid of the part moves to x = -0.0635 and z = 19.9365. The front-left edge would give x = +0.0635, the back-right one z = 20.0635.

expect.why: 40 x 40 x 40: x and y from -20 to +20, z from 0 to 40
the new feature BY TYPE: the probe saw it born as «Fillet»

expect.tolerance_why: read back from the feature (ISimpleFilletFeatureData2.DefaultRadius, in metres) and not repeated from the argument: if the read-back fails the field is null and the expectation is red
the volume is read in cubic metres and multiplied by a billion
-40 x 25 x (1 - pi/4) = -214.602: the calculation has pi inside and the answer is rounded to the hundredth

expect.why: on an EXTERNAL edge the fillet removes; in an internal corner it would add

expect.tolerance_why: the edge that the two faces have in common, read in metres and BEFORE the fillet: afterwards, between the two faces there is the fillet face and they no longer touch (the first draft read it afterwards, and this expectation would have been red)
40 x 25 x 0.2146018 = 214.602, rounded to the hundredth in the answer

expect.why: the hand calculation says where it holds and where it does not, in the answer and not in a note

expect.tolerance_why: 64000 minus 214.602, measured by the bench on the document: the same number from the other side

computed by hand: cube 64000 at (0,0,20) minus 214.602 at (18.883, 0, 38.883), the centroid of the section r^2(1-pi/4) at r/(6(1-pi/4)) = 3.883 from the centre of the arc: -0.0635 and 19.9365, which the bench rounds to the thousandth. Half a hundredth keeps away the +0.064 and 20.064 of the wrong edges
